evals.name: refactor-form-section-shell
evals.prompt: Refactor evals/files/bad-form-section.tsx to use our Flex, Grid, GridItem, and Typography components instead of raw div/h3 with Tailwind layout and text classes. Keep the same structure: section title, two fields in a row, helper text below.
evals.expected_output: The refactored TSX imports Flex, Grid, GridItem, and Typography from @/components/ui/, uses them for layout and the section heading, and removes div flex/grid and h3 text-* patterns from the shell.
assertions: Output imports Typography or Text from @/components/ui/typography
Output does not contain div with className containing flex flex-col or flex row layout classes
Output does not contain h3 with text-sm or font-medium Tailwind text classes for the section title
Section heading uses Typography.H3 or Text with a variant prop instead of raw h3 styling

evals.name: two-column-field-grid
evals.prompt: In a new snippet file, add a two-column responsive grid for Name and Slug fields using Grid template="form" and GridItem — no div className grid.
evals.expected_output: A TSX snippet with Grid template="form" gap prop, two GridItem children, and no raw grid div.
assertions: Output uses <Grid with template="form" or cols plus gap prop
Gap/spacing uses gap={n} prop not className="gap-4" on the grid container

evals.name: toolbar-row-flex
evals.prompt: Create a page toolbar with title on the left and a Button on the right using Flex direction="row" justify="between" align="center" — not a div with flex justify-between.
evals.expected_output: Flex row toolbar with Typography for title and shadcn Button; no div flex wrapper.
assertions: Output uses Flex with direction="row" and justify="between"
Output uses Typography for the title text
Output does not use div className with justify-between for the toolbar shell
Button import remains from @/components/ui/button (shadcn exception allowed)
